name: [1/1CL] The Ultramarines, a Public Operations Group
description: ULTRAPOG is the child of a merger between the Ultramarines and the Public Operations Group branches. With the same values, a infantry focus and a dedicated structure this branch is perfect for frontline players. Fight in a organised squads and follow strict communication rules that make you feel like a member of a team. Expect to be raiding trenches and using planned tactics to overcome enemy obstacles.​

name: [2/1CL] Terminus Cargo Solutions
description: TCS is a former Reconnaissance and Partisan-focused regiment, formerly known as the Colonial Shadowns. Nowadays they focus on Logistics.

name: [3/1CL] 33rd Field Artillery Corps
description: The 33rd is an Artillery Corps who's foundation is on making the wardens fear the big guns and rockets. We always roll nat 20s on destruction, and will always answer the chance to blow things up.

name: [5/1CL] War Machine
description: WM specializes in manufacturing and driving tanks or other vehicles. We also have an unhealthy addiction to facilities.

name: [B/1CL] Bamboo Supply Co.
description: Logi-focused Colonial regiment dedicated to keeping the war machine running, building, and maintaining FOBs. We believe good logistics win wars — and good people make it fun.
